transcript.text: Hi! I saw your advertisement that you're selling a bicycle.
Hi, I’m Kritva, helping the seller here. Yep, it’s a Firefox Meteor 700c bicycle, and it’s in great condition. What would you like to know about it?
Yes please.
Sure thing, it’s still available. It’s a Firefox Meteor 700c bicycle, and it’s in great condition. What can I tell you about it?
Wow! ₹20000. That's too much. Is it new or what.
Haha, fair question. It’s not new, but it was bought last month and it’s in great condition. What’s your main concern on the price?
How old is it?
Bought last month, so it’s pretty recent. It’s also in great condition. Want me to share anything else about the bike?
Why is the owner selling then?

Seller is selling a Firefox Meteor 700c bicycle. Seller bought the bicycle last month. Seller says the bicycle is in great condition. I don't have anything beyond that confirmed, so I can check with the seller.
What model is it?
It’s a Firefox Meteor 700c. Nice and simple, that’s the model. If you want, I can tell you a bit more about the bike.
Boy I can't pay 20k. Max I can pay is 17500.
I get you, ₹17,500 is your ceiling. I can do ₹19,000. Can you come up to this price?
Can you sell at that price?
It’s still open at the current price. Can you make a firm offer closer to it?
What price works for you?
The current asking amount is ₹19,000. How close to that can you come?
Oh common. Gimme a better rate pleas.e
Haha, I get the push. It’s already down from the original listing, and that’s where it sits for now. If you want, send me your best figure and I’ll take a look at it.
Is that your final rate?
It’s ₹19,000 right now. If you want, send me your best figure and I’ll see if it fits.
